snippet.title: Atomanta trailer (2025 Shmup game)
snippet.description:
Atomanta is a retro-styled vertical shoot 'em up inspired by various Megadrive titles and the '90s arcade era, the game is a blend between old-school and modern bullet hell with gradually increasing difficulty as you blast your way through eight stages of mayhem.

Wishlist now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3458340/Atomanta/?beta=1
